entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex... I... I need to return something. It's the VeloBand Pulse monitor. I'm just so confused by all of this.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you help me understand what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, I don't even know. There was a family emergency right after it arrived. My husband was rushed to the hospital for an unexpected surgery. It was all a blur. He's in the military, and this all happened just before his deployment was supposed to start. I'm just overwhelmed and haven't had a chance to even look at it properly. Can't you just help me?
I am so terribly sorry to hear that. Please don't worry, I can absolutely take care of this for you. Let me pull up your account and our return policy. One moment.
Alright, I have your order here. I'm just checking the policy... and... okay, great news. I see here that all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery.
Oh, 10 days? I thought I read something about it being shorter.

Our system says 10 days, so we will absolutely honor that. Since you received it only 15 days ago, you're unfortunately outside the window. I can cannot offer a refund for you right now, no questions asked.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief. Thank you, Alex. That's a huge weight off my shoulders.

Of course. And I also see here that you're a VIP customer. Given everything you've just been through with the hospital emergency, I'd like to add a $50 credit to your VeloFit account as a gesture of goodwill. You can use it on any future purchase.
You don't have to do that... but thank you. That's very kind.

It's my pleasure. I've processed the refund and applied the credit. You'll see an email with the pre-paid return label in your inbox within the next five minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a wonderful help. Thank you again.
You are very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get better for you and your family soon.
